title: Auto-mode classifier spend is not counted in the footer or session cost
observed: kiln defect (accuracy). Auto session s2: footer and 'kiln session inspect' both total $1.40 (agent usage only). The run log shows 22 classifier calls on Opus (modelRoles.fast unset) with 170,799 cache-write, 50,694 cache-read and 2,007 output tokens, about $1.14 at the rates kiln itself uses (derived, not measured by kiln), i.e. ~80% on top of what the footer shows.
expected: Include classifier calls in the session cost (or show them as a separate line in /cost), so auto mode's real cost is visible.
